scope: Generic public source package; historical pilot details are retained separately
usage: Supply your own observation ROOT, source-group split and trained checkpoint explicitly. Evaluate every frozen test case and retain failure and score coverage.
limits: Synthetic software checks do not establish detector accuracy
An observed-waveform decomposition is not proof of unique physical identifiability
Physical trajectories, Si energy inversion and mass correlations require separately validated inputs
No 120-degree or equal-energy constraint is imposed on reconstruction
